experiment_data.hypothesis: VC-weighted entity construction outperforms greedy and LP-weighted construction across configs because Vote Count is a more direct quality estimator for structured outputs — it measures exact-match consensus without relying on model-internal log probabilities. Especially effective in high-degeneracy regimes where LP compression makes LP-weighting uninformative.

qwen3_8b_ft_supplement.note: VC inconsistent on LP-success configs; seed-dependent on FewNERD; CoNLL all negative due to high degeneracy

experiment_data.notes: COMPLETE (28 configs). VC-weighted construction: 9 sig+ / 10 sig- / 9 ns. Qwen3-8B FT supplement (9 configs): 3+/3-/3ns — VC inconsistent even on LP-success configs. SciERC s42 best (+1.40pp) but cross-seed unstable. CoNLL all negative (high degeneracy). WNUT17/SciERC lean positive but not robust. Key answer: VC does NOT reliably improve where LP already works — seed-dependent, dataset-dependent. DGEC unified method goal (70-80% configs) unreachable at 32% (9/28). Closed per D170/D171.
